summary: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for FY2025. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 confirms this ordinary disclosure. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is described. The filing is a routine reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer.
